rules.text: Enter the Artistic Cataclysm chakra stance as a Bonus action (the clan's stance item: Clay Bombings is its attack button).

You gain the other nature release (Earth or Lightning; set it on the sheet). Earth or Lightning Release jutsu can deal force damage instead (change the type when you roll). Learn three Payloads (five at 11th) and prepare two (three at 11th) after each rest; one Payload rides one detonation, Dexterity save against your highest jutsu save DC unless it says otherwise.

activities.label: Detonate Primes
activities.text: Action, Bonus Action or Reaction on your turn: every Prime explodes, a 5-foot radius (+5 feet per extra Prime on that creature or object). Each creature takes this damage for every Prime on that same target, half on a success; caught in overlapping explosions, only one (you choose).

rules.text: Primes active at once: 4 (5 at 7th, 6 at 15th), the Primes pool; spend them back (the pool) when they detonate. Damage per Prime on the same target: multiply the damage roll by the count.

You gain the other nature release (Earth or Lightning; set it on the sheet). Earth or Lightning Release jutsu can deal force damage instead. Learn three Payloads (five at 11th), prepare two (three at 11th) after each rest. You can detonate a single Primed creature by dealing [Unarmed Damage] to it; its Payload can reshape the area. You're immune to your own Payloads.

activities.label: Clay Bombings
activities.text: A creature you can see within 60 feet, with your highest jutsu attack bonus. A 12 on a damage die: add 1 more die.

rules.text: In place of any attacks of the Attack action, or of a Bakuton Hijutsu that needs an attack. At 7th, without Extra Attack, the Attack action makes two Clay Bombings; barriers, structures and constructs treat its damage as if vulnerable. Clay constructs you command all act on the same Bonus action.

Your [Unarmed Damage] is 2d8 force and adds no ability modifier (the stance, King Q-E7). Unarmed attacks have Deadly 1 (Deadly 2 at 7th, 3 at 15th). Resistance to damage from your own clan features. At 7th, without Extra Attack, the Attack action attacks twice.
